QuestInfo.name: Brothers in Arms
QuestInfo.1: Your mission is to find a Resistance member, part of the liberation army of Edelstein. Join a party with #ba Lv. 150+ Resistance class player#k.\r\n\r\n#r<<You must make a party with a player on the same screen.>>#k
